entries.feed_content: Welcome — this is a **read-only** feed. It loads from `content.json`; place that file next to `index.html` to activate read-only mode. Full manual: [help reference](assets/help.md).
Entries are Markdown: headings, lists, links, code, tables, math ($E = mc^2$), and Mermaid diagrams all render.
Tag entries with hashtags like #welcome and #demo — type `#` in the search bar to browse every tag.
Link to a saved search from any entry: [posts tagged #welcome](?search=%23welcome). Images use `![alt](assets/your-image.png)`.
